details:
Grafana is an open source, feature rich metrics dashboard and graph editor for Graphite, InfluxDB & OpenTSDB.   

Security Fix(es):  

  * net/[http](http): golang: golang.org/x/net/http2: net/[http](http): HTTP response smuggling via malformed HTTP/2 framing headers (CVE-2026-78660)
  * grafana: IMAGE RENDER KEYS COULD BE REPLAYED ACROSS GRAFANA INSTANCES THAT SHARE A RENDERER TOKEN (CVE-2026-102589)
  * grafana: ELASTICSEARCH DATA SOURCE COULD BE USED TO SEND ARBITRARY REQUESTS TO ELASTICSEARCH (CVE-2026-106475)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
